title: The Fantastics Album Cover
coreRelationships: The four men are centrally grouped, forming a cohesive unit under the arch.
The rose arch frames the group, drawing attention to them and creating a sense of theatricality.
The vibrant red and white of the suits strongly contrast with the dark background and the earthy tones of the arch.
The illustrative style of the arch and roses provides a decorative backdrop for the photographic subjects.
